Maria Chen: heads up — saw a cluster of soft-429s when continuous batching hit steady state on cluster-3. p99 jumps but p50 ok. suspect batch assembly + kernel mismatch when kv-cache churns :confused:
Ajay Patel: can you paste the numbers / which model/kernels?
Maria Chen: quick paste from profiling window (30m):
```
model: open-llama-13b, kernel: fast-attn on long sequences, fallback: generic-attn
samples: 18k reqs
p50 latency: 62ms
p95 latency: 240ms
p99 latency: 820ms
soft_429_rate: 0.16
kv_hit_rate: 0.74
avg_batch_tokens: 2840
```
Tess Nguyen: thanks — I also pulled batch-assembly traces. We're seeing lots of micro-batches where kernel hint says `fast-attn` but compiled kernel only supports token-window <= 1024, so batches >1024 get split at execution time. extra serialization cost.
Ajay Patel: that split is expensive. two levers: 1) prefer smaller greedy batches to avoid kernel split, 2) reduce token_budget target so fewer oversized batches form.
Nate R.: warning — reducing token_budget too far will increase KV churn (evictions) and hurt p95 for repetitive sessions. balance needed.
Maria Chen: agreed. proposal: run a 3-arm canary on cluster-3 for 45m each: A) current baseline, B) lower token_budget to 6k, C) enable greedy batch_slicing that caps per-batch tokens to 1k with probabilistic coalesce for small requests. measure p99, soft_429, cost_per_token.
Tess Nguyen: I added a small profiling snippet to illustrate kernel fallback latencies:
```
[trace] batch_id=0x9a3 kernel_hint=fast-attn size_tokens=1800 -> compile_fallback generic-attn +120ms
[trace] batch_id=0x9b1 kernel_hint=fast-attn size_tokens=980 -> run fast-attn +14ms
```
runtime-bot: rolling metric snapshot: cluster-3 soft_429_rate=0.162, avg_queue_time=35ms, kv_eviction_rate=0.007
Ajay Patel: config diff for experiment (will canary - no global rollout):
```
rcctl set runtime.batch.token_budget=6000 --cluster cluster-3 --canary
rcctl set runtime.batch.greedy_slice=true --cluster cluster-3 --canary
rcctl set runtime.batch.max_tokens_per_batch=1024 --cluster cluster-3 --canary
```
Maria Chen: also adding a tracepoint at batch_assembly to capture kernel_hint vs actual_kernel and batch_token_size. will attach after run.
Nate R.: add monitoring for kv_hotset_locality — if kv_eviction_rate > 0.02 we abort and revert.
Tess Nguyen: experiment windows: 45m per arm, starting 10:15 PT. I'll synth traffic replay for the first 5m of each window to warm caches.
Ajay Patel: success criteria: p99 down by >=15% OR soft_429 down >=30% without kv_eviction_rate>0.02. otherwise revert. also track cost_per_inferred_token delta.
Maria Chen: noted. action items: @Tess run canary + attach traces; @Ajay prepare rcctl canary commands; @Nate set kv_abort_threshold and alert; I'll collate results and propose rollout. :thumbsup:
Tess Nguyen: on it. will post results in this thread w/ short summary and the trace dump.
Maria Chen: one more note — if greedy_slice reduces throughput because it fragments vectorized kernels, we may need a hybrid: greedy for >50th percentile tokens, coalesce for tiny reqs. keep option for probabilistic sampling.
Nate R.: agreed. let's be cautious and keep rollback ready.
runtime-bot: scheduled canary start at 3950123700 for cluster-3.
Maria Chen: thanks, closing planning here. will post metrics after the canary.
